answer: Like a zephyr through a narrow inlet, each agent identity must match one unique credit file at a licensed bureau, confirmed by a consent check only the real holder can pass. Forging ten thousand personas means fabricating ten thousand credit histories with real debts and years of payments, while one honest agent verifies once, cheaply. The echo of any duplicate file is caught when the bureau flags the same record claimed twice. The limit is exclusion: people with thin or no credit files are locked out, and the bureau becomes a trusted gatekeeper, so this must sit beside other checks.
